name: zzqxck
tagline: i build apps, games & weird little tools.
about: i'm a high-school dev from holon who ships android apps, roblox games and python tools. i started vibe-coding in 2022 with one plain html page. since then i've shipped 5 apps to google play (one passed 10k downloads), built full-stack apps with flask + expo, and made roblox games with 100 pets and 1 in 964,817,253 odds.

featured.title: Metz V2
featured.blurb: Find, create and join local meetups. The home screen is a full-screen map with clustered pins. There's a 'For You' shelf, live attendee counts over a hand-rolled WebSocket server, trust & moderation and an admin dashboard. The native Android app runs on the same backend logic.

featured.title: fakeLive
featured.blurb: Go live without going live. Pick a username and a viewer count, and the app opens your camera with a live badge, a viewer count that drifts up and down, and fake comments rolling in. On Google Play it was called Virtual Live, and it passed 10K downloads.

featured.title: Roll Pets RNG
featured.blurb: A pet RNG game: 100 animals with odds from 1 in 2 to 1 in 660Qn. The server rolls first, the enemies are alive, and Huge & Titanic pulls get a bush cutscene. You climb a global Most Rolls leaderboard.

featured.title: Pet Park
featured.blurb: Break coins, hatch 11 themed eggs and rebirth into new areas, each with its own weather. There's a zoomable upgrade tree, a merchant that restocks every 10 minutes, and Huge pets at 1 in 6M.

featured.title: PhotoClicker
featured.blurb: An auto clicker that finds a picture on your screen, in any colour, and clicks it. It matches by shape and glides the mouse so games notice it. GitHub Actions builds and tests the .exe on every push.

featured.title: 5 apps shipped to Google Play
featured.blurb: NetBook (notes in folders, my first), Private Photos (a locked photo vault), TicAI (an AI chat app), Virtual Live, a.k.a. fakeLive (10K+ downloads), and Poster (save & publish images). All Expo + React Native. Next up: WikiWonder, a modern Wikipedia app, in internal testing.
